A verification script now passes clean: 11 skills, 4 subagents, 5 plugins, every rule in CLAUDE.md satisfied. Note: the folder is **not a git repo** (`git status` fails), so I couldn't inspect an actual commit — I checked the working tree instead.

| What was wrong | What I changed |
|---|---|
| `.claude/skills/voice-video` was a broken symlink (`skills/voice_video`, underscore) | Re-pointed to `../../plugins/avatar-video/skills/voice-video` |
| `.claude/skills/x-image` symlink missing entirely | Added `ln -s ../../plugins/x-assistant/skills/x-image` |
| `.claude/agents/x-reviewer.md` symlink missing | Added `ln -s ../../plugins/x-assistant/agents/x-reviewer.md` |
| `.claude/skills/quick-notes/` was a real skill dir directly in `.claude/` (not third-party) | Moved to `plugins/quick-notes/skills/quick-notes/SKILL.md`, added `plugins/quick-notes/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, symlinked it back |
| `plugins/diagrams/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` had `"name": "diagram"` ≠ folder name | Changed to `"diagrams"` |
| `plugins/avatar-video/.../plugin.json` had no `description` | Added `"The avatar-video plugin."` |
| `plugins/outlook-email/.../plugin.json` had no `version` | Added `"version": "0.1.0"` |
| `diagrams` and `quick-notes` plugins absent from `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` | Added both entries |
| `plugins/avatar-video/agents/video-scripter.md` frontmatter had no `name` | Added `name: video-scripter` |
| `plugins/x-assistant/skills/xhs-post/SKILL.md` frontmatter had no `description` | Added a description line |
| README missing rows for `youtube-post`, `video-reviewer`, `quick-notes` | Added the three rows |

Two judgment calls worth knowing:
- I moved `quick-notes` into a **new `quick-notes` plugin** (it fits none of the existing plugins) rather than deleting it — revert that if you'd rather file it elsewhere.
- I did not add README rows for the third-party skills (`heygen-avatar`, `heygen-video`, `hyperframes`, `media-use`); they're installer-managed and untouched (original mtimes intact).
